annotations.title: PIT settlement in Poland by tax year (Ministry of Finance)

description: Use for how many people in Poland settle PIT, how many are in the second tax bracket and what share of tax they pay, how many use child relief, IKZE or other reliefs, overpayments, flat tax and lump-sum tax returns. For PIT by municipality, use get_regional_data. For tax rates and limits, use get_legal_limits. National statistics of the annual PIT settlement from the yearly Ministry of Finance information (every tax year since 2019): taxpayers on the tax scale, returns by form (PIT-36, PIT-36L, PIT-37, PIT-38, PIT-39, PIT-28 lump-sum), taxpayers in the first and second bracket with the threshold and the second bracket share in tax due, reliefs deducted from income (IKZE, thermal modernisation, internet, rehabilitation, donations, trade union dues) with taxpayers, amount and average, child relief (taxpayers, children, amount), overpayments in returns, flat tax, capital gains and crypto income, and the finwire index finwire_pit_top_bracket_multiplier. Optional year selects one tax year. For PIT by municipality use get_regional_data; for tax rates and limits use get_legal_limits.

year.description: Tax year; default the latest published.
